domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report India split could be retrieved: thecompanycheck.com and zaubacorp.com returned HTTP 403 Forbidden, and the Weir plc annual-report page timed out. Domestic supply therefore not verified — null, not inferred from the export records.
note: All three legal entities are distinct companies that appear as separate shippers in Indian customs export data, so export activity is factually confirmed for each, not merely declared. HS codes actually shipped are 84818030 / 84818090 (industrial valves and valve spares) for BDK and Swims, and 732690 for Weir India — the declared HS set 730610;842489;848180 does not match the observed records, so the code should be corrected to the factual 84818030/84818090 (and 732690 for Weir) per the HS-correction rule; this is not a rejection ground. The claimed industry "IT и электроника" is wrong for all three — the shipment descriptions are industrial valves, valve spares and hydraulic tooling, i.e. mechanical/flow-control engineering. BDK and Swims share the same office address block (DLF Tower B, Plot No. 11, Jasola, New Delhi — units 1211 and 1212-1215) and the same overseas buyers (KDV Flow Ltd UK, BP Mauritania, SED Flow Control GmbH, ILK Insaat Turkey), which suggests a related/group structure rather than three independent suppliers; worth flagging to the buyer. Swims' latest visible record is 2024-10-10, i.e. roughly 16 months stale as of the data cut. Domestic (India) supply evidence is unverified for all three — no GST band or tender data was publicly retrievable within the tool budget, so domestic_status is unknown, not none_found. No PAN, CIN or revenue figures were obtained and none are asserted here.
